stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 4 of “A Little Common Courtesy, Please.”

We teach these manners to children so that they can use them throughout their lives.

Which event from “The View from Saturday” best demonstrates this message?

options.label: A
options.text: Noah’s mother insists that he write a thank-you letter to his grandparents.

options.label: B
options.text: Noah’s mother expresses concern about the youth of her sons’ generation.

options.label: C
options.text: Noah explains why he believes he should receive a thank-you letter.

options.label: D
options.text: Noah points out that his brother has something to be thankful for.

visual_elements: sentence in box: We teach these manners to children so that they can use them throughout their lives.
